grammar: n. 表达；交流，通常不可数。动词为 communicate；也可指通信、交流的方式。
collocations: communication skills; communication with sb; a means of communication
commonMistake: communication 是名词，communicate 是动词；泛指交流时通常不加 a。

example.english: Good communication helps friends understand each other.
example.chinese: 良好的沟通有助于朋友相互理解。

application.solution: A。解析：good 后需要名词 communication；communicate 是动词。
application.prompt: Listening is an important part of good ___. A. communication B. communicate

grammar: adv. 面对面地，通常作状语；可用 face to face with sb 表示与某人面对面。
collocations: talk face to face; meet face to face; face to face with a problem
commonMistake: 作副词短语时通常不加连字符；作定语时用 face-to-face。

example.english: The two students talked face to face after class.
example.chinese: 两名学生课后面对面交谈。

application.solution: A。解析：这里修饰动词 discuss，作状语用不带连字符的 face to face。
application.prompt: They chose to discuss the problem ___ instead of texting. A. face to face B. face-to-face

grammar: n. （手机）短信；短信，可数。
collocations: send a text message; receive a text message; text message sb
commonMistake: text message 是可数名词，单数前用 a/an；text 也可作动词表示给某人发短信。

example.english: I sent my friend a text message about the meeting.
example.chinese: 我给朋友发了一条关于会议的短信。

application.solution: B。解析：手机上发出的文字信息是 text message。
application.prompt: I sent a short ___ to tell her I was late. A. speech B. text message

grammar: n. 手势；迹象；标志；v. 签（名）；签字。
collocations: a road sign; a sign of change; sign a form
commonMistake: sign 作名词可指标志或迹象，作动词表示签署；“签一份表格”直接说 sign a form。

example.english: Please sign your name at the bottom of the form.
example.chinese: 请在表格底部签上你的名字。

application.solution: B。解析：在文件上签字用动词 sign；signal 通常表示发信号。
application.prompt: Please ___ the form before you leave. A. signal B. sign

grammar: n. 说话者；发言者，可数；也可指扬声器。
collocations: a guest speaker; a public speaker; listen to the speaker
commonMistake: speaker 指说话或发言的人；扬声器也可称 speaker，需根据语境判断。

example.english: The speaker answered questions from the students.
example.chinese: 发言者回答了学生们的问题。

application.solution: B。解析：讲话的人是 speaker，听众是 listener。
application.prompt: The person giving a talk to the audience is the ___. A. listener B. speaker

grammar: n. 排演；排练，可数。动词为 rehearse。
collocations: have a rehearsal; a dress rehearsal; rehearse for a play
commonMistake: rehearsal 是名词，rehearse 是动词；“进行排练”可说 have a rehearsal。

example.english: The actors had a rehearsal before the school play.
example.chinese: 演员们在学校话剧演出前进行了排练。

application.solution: B。解析：正式演出前的排演是 rehearsal。
application.prompt: The actors practised the play together at a ___. A. reunion B. rehearsal

grammar: phr. 领某人参观；带某人四处看看。结构为 show + 人 + around + 地点。
collocations: show a visitor around; show us around the school; show sb around town
commonMistake: 人称代词放在 show 和 around 之间：show us around；地点通常放在 around 后。

example.english: Our guide showed us around the new library.
example.chinese: 导游带我们参观了新图书馆。

application.solution: B。解析：带访客参观某地用 show sb around。
application.prompt: When the visitors arrive, I will ___ the school. A. find them out B. show them around

grammar: adj. 当地的；地方的；n. 当地人，本地人。
collocations: local people; a local newspaper; local shops
commonMistake: local 作名词指当地人时常用复数 locals；不要与 location（地点）混淆。

example.english: We asked a local for directions to the station.
example.chinese: 我们向一位当地人问去车站的路。

application.solution: B。解析：当地居民可称 a local。
application.prompt: A person who lives in the area is a ___. A. professor B. local

grammar: adj. 面对面的，作定语修饰名词，常带连字符。
collocations: face-to-face communication; a face-to-face meeting; face-to-face contact
commonMistake: 作名词前定语时写 face-to-face；作状语时通常写 face to face。

example.english: Face-to-face communication lets us notice people's expressions.
example.chinese: 面对面的交流能让我们注意到人们的表情。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 meeting 作定语时用带连字符的 face-to-face。
application.prompt: They arranged a ___ meeting with the professor. A. face to face B. face-to-face

grammar: n. 教授，可数。
collocations: a professor of history; university professor; Professor Lee
commonMistake: 普通名词 professor 前常用 a；作称谓置于姓名前时首字母大写。

example.english: The professor gave a speech about communication.
example.chinese: 教授发表了一场关于交流的演讲。

application.solution: B。解析：表示职业身份“教授”用 a professor。
application.prompt: Dr. Lin is ___ at the university. A. a speech B. a professor

grammar: n. 演说；发言，可数；也可泛指说话能力（不可数）。
collocations: give a speech; make a speech; a speech about communication
commonMistake: 表示一场演讲时是可数名词，常说 give/make a speech；不要误用 speak 作名词。

example.english: Our class monitor gave a short speech at the meeting.
example.chinese: 班长在会上作了简短发言。

application.solution: B。解析：准备的内容是一场演讲，用 speech；speaker 是发言者。
application.prompt: Lily prepared a ___ about being a good listener. A. speaker B. speech

grammar: v. 争论；争吵；提出理由。过去式/过去分词 argued；名词 argument。
collocations: argue with sb; argue about/over sth; argue that ...
commonMistake: argue with sb 表示与某人争论，argue about sth 表示争论某事；不要用 argue someone。

example.english: They argued about which topic to choose for the speech.
example.chinese: 他们为演讲选哪个话题而争论。

application.solution: A。解析：begin to 后接动词原形 argue；argument 是名词。
application.prompt: The two friends began to ___ about the plan. A. argue B. argument

grammar: phr. 与某人言归于好；和解。过去式 made up。
collocations: make up with a friend; make up after an argument; make up with sb
commonMistake: 这里 make up with 表示和好；makeup（一个词）常指化妆品，不要混淆词义和拼写。

example.english: After their disagreement, the two friends made up with each other.
example.chinese: 意见不合后，这两个朋友和好了。

application.solution: A。解析：与朋友和好用 make up with sb。
application.prompt: After the argument, Jo called her friend to ___. A. make up with her B. take place with her

grammar: adv. 亲自；亲身。常与 meet, speak, visit 等动词搭配。
collocations: meet in person; speak to sb in person; apply in person
commonMistake: in person 是固定副词短语，person 前不加冠词；不要写成 in the person。

example.english: I would like to meet the new coach in person.
example.chinese: 我想亲自见见新教练。

application.solution: A。解析：亲自询问用 in person。
application.prompt: You can ask the professor questions ___ after the talk. A. in person B. by a person

grammar: v. 较喜欢；更愿意。过去式 preferred；常用 prefer A to B、prefer to do 或 prefer doing。
collocations: prefer tea to coffee; prefer to walk; prefer doing A to doing B
commonMistake: prefer A to B 中用 to 而非 than；prefer 的过去式双写 r：preferred。

example.english: I prefer talking face to face to sending long messages.
example.chinese: 比起发长短信，我更喜欢面对面交谈。

application.solution: B。解析：主语 Nina 是第三人称单数，谓语用 prefers；结构为 prefer A to B。
application.prompt: Nina ___ meeting people in person to texting them. A. prefer B. prefers

grammar: adj. 镇静的；沉着的；v. 使平静；使镇静。
collocations: stay calm; calm down; calm sb down
commonMistake: calm 可作形容词或动词；calm down 表示平静下来，不能把 calm 与 quiet（安静的）简单等同。

example.english: Take a deep breath and try to stay calm before the speech.
example.chinese: 演讲前深呼吸，尽量保持冷静。

application.solution: B。解析：安抚紧张的学生用动词 calm。
application.prompt: The teacher spoke gently to ___ the nervous student. A. worry B. calm

grammar: phr. 为……担心。可接名词、代词或动名词；be worried about 为形容词结构。
collocations: worry about an exam; worry about sb; be worried about the result
commonMistake: worry about 后接名词或动名词；不要说 worry for sth 表示“担心某事”。

example.english: Mia worries about speaking in front of the class.
example.chinese: 米娅担心在全班面前讲话。

application.solution: B。解析：为犯小错误而担心用 worry about。
application.prompt: Don't ___ making a small mistake; you can try again. A. take place B. worry about

grammar: n. 表达方式；表达；表情，可数。动词为 express。
collocations: an expression of thanks; facial expression; expression of an idea
commonMistake: expression 可指语言表达或面部表情；动词“表达”是 express，注意词性。

example.english: A smile is a friendly expression.
example.chinese: 微笑是一种友好的表情。

application.solution: A。解析：面部所表现出的情感或神态是 expression。
application.prompt: A look on someone's face that shows a feeling is an ___. A. expression B. communication

grammar: n. 机会；可能性；adj. 意外的、偶然的。
collocations: a chance to do sth; have a chance of doing sth; by chance
commonMistake: chance 后可接 to do 或 of doing；不要把 chance of 后的动词写成原形。

example.english: I had a chance to speak with the professor after class.
example.chinese: 课后我有机会和教授交谈。

application.solution: A。解析：做某事的机会是 a chance to do sth。
application.prompt: The students had a ___ to practise their speeches. A. chance B. detail

grammar: n. 会面；会议，可数。动词为 meet。
collocations: have a meeting; attend a meeting; a meeting with sb
commonMistake: meeting 是 meet 的名词形式；表示参加会议用 attend a meeting，不说 attend to a meeting。

example.english: The school will hold a meeting about the new project.
example.chinese: 学校将召开一次关于新项目的会议。

application.solution: B。解析：团队成员一起讨论事务的活动是 meeting。
application.prompt: All team members will attend a ___ on Friday. A. line B. meeting

grammar: n. 困难；难题，可数或不可数。常用 have difficulty (in) doing sth。
collocations: have difficulty doing sth; a difficulty with pronunciation; face difficulties
commonMistake: have difficulty 后接动名词 doing；不要接 to do。

example.english: He had difficulty understanding the speaker's accent.
example.chinese: 他听懂发言者的口音有困难。

application.solution: A。解析：some 后用名词 difficulty；have difficulty doing 表示做某事有困难。
application.prompt: I had some ___ finding the meeting room. A. difficulty B. difficult

grammar: adv. 立即；马上。常置于句末或动词短语后。
collocations: answer right away; call sb right away; do it right away
commonMistake: right away 是副词短语，表示“马上”；right 在此不是“正确的”。

example.english: Please reply to the message right away.
example.chinese: 请马上回复这条信息。

application.solution: A。解析：时间紧，需要立即离开，用 right away。
application.prompt: The meeting starts in five minutes, so we must leave ___. A. right away B. one by one

grammar: n. 字行；便条；线；电话线路，可数。
collocations: a line of text; wait in line; a phone line
commonMistake: line 意义较多，结合语境辨义；表示“排队”常说 wait in line。

example.english: She wrote one line of thanks in the card.
example.chinese: 她在卡片上写了一行感谢的话。

application.solution: B。解析：一行文字用 line。
application.prompt: The short message has only one ___. A. clause B. line

grammar: phr. 给某人写信；给某人留言。sb 可用 me/us/them 等宾格代词。
collocations: drop me a line; drop sb a line soon; drop a line to a friend
commonMistake: 结构是 drop + 人 + a line；人称代词用宾格，如 drop me a line。

example.english: Drop me a line when you get to the city.
example.chinese: 你到这座城市后给我写信。

application.solution: B。解析：请给我写信或留言用 drop me a line。
application.prompt: If you have time, please ___ and tell me how the visit went. A. pay attention B. drop me a line

grammar: n. 细节；详情，可数。常用 in detail，details about/of。
collocations: in detail; attention to detail; details of the plan
commonMistake: detail 是可数名词，具体细节常用复数 details；“详细地”说 in detail。

example.english: The speaker explained the plan in detail.
example.chinese: 发言者详细解释了计划。

application.solution: A。解析：具体的时间和地点信息可称 details；detailly 不是常用英语表达。
application.prompt: Please tell us the ___ of the meeting place and time. A. details B. detailly

grammar: n. 团聚；重逢；聚会，可数。动词为 reunite。
collocations: a family reunion; a class reunion; hold a reunion
commonMistake: reunion 是名词，reunite 是动词；不要把 reunion 和 meeting 完全等同，前者强调重聚。

example.english: Our class reunion brought old friends together again.
example.chinese: 我们的同学聚会让老朋友们再次相聚。

application.solution: B。解析：老同学重聚的聚会是 reunion。
application.prompt: Former classmates met again at a school ___. A. rehearsal B. reunion

grammar: adv. 严肃地；认真地。形容词 serious；常用 take sth seriously。
collocations: take advice seriously; think seriously about; speak seriously
commonMistake: seriously 是副词，修饰动词；be 后作表语用 serious。

example.english: We should take the speaker's advice seriously.
example.chinese: 我们应该认真对待发言者的建议。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 listened 用副词 seriously。
application.prompt: The students listened ___ to the instructions. A. serious B. seriously

grammar: n. 训练；培训，通常不可数。动词 train。
collocations: receive training; a training course; training in first aid
commonMistake: training 泛指训练或培训时通常不可数；不能说 a training，具体课程可说 a training course。

example.english: The volunteers received training in communication skills.
example.chinese: 志愿者接受了沟通技巧培训。

application.solution: A。解析：泛指培训时 training 通常不可数。
application.prompt: The new staff need more ___ before they begin the work. A. training B. trainings

grammar: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；胆怯的。
collocations: feel nervous; be nervous about sth; nervous before a speech
commonMistake: nervous 描述人的紧张感；令别人紧张的事物可用 nerve-racking 等，不用 nervous。

example.english: I feel nervous before speaking to a large audience.
example.chinese: 在面对很多听众讲话前，我会感到紧张。

application.solution: A。解析：felt 后作表语需用形容词 nervous；nervousness 是名词。
application.prompt: Ella felt ___ before giving her first speech. A. nervous B. nervousness

grammar: n. 陌生人，可数。形容词 strange。
collocations: a stranger to the town; talk to a stranger; a complete stranger
commonMistake: stranger 是“陌生人”名词；strange 是“陌生的、奇怪的”形容词，注意词性。

example.english: A stranger asked me for directions outside the station.
example.chinese: 一个陌生人在车站外向我问路。

application.solution: A。解析：不认识的人是 stranger；listener 只是听者，不一定陌生。
application.prompt: Do not share personal information with a ___. A. stranger B. listener

grammar: n. 实用提示；指点；尖端；v. （使）倾斜；倒出；给小费。
collocations: a useful tip; the tip of a finger; tip a waiter
commonMistake: tip 可作名词或动词，意义依语境变化；不要只按“提示”理解所有用法。

example.english: One useful tip is to look at the audience while speaking.
example.chinese: 一个实用建议是讲话时看着听众。

application.solution: A。解析：物体最末端的尖端可称 tip。
application.prompt: The sharp ___ of the pencil broke. A. tip B. line

grammar: adv. 认真地；仔细地；小心地。形容词 careful。
collocations: listen carefully; read carefully; drive carefully
commonMistake: carefully 是副词，修饰动作；修饰名词用 careful，不要漏掉 -ly。

example.english: Listen carefully when your partner is speaking.
example.chinese: 搭档讲话时要认真听。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 read 要用副词 carefully。
application.prompt: Read the instructions ___ before you sign the form. A. careful B. carefully

grammar: phr. 对……表现出兴趣。in 为介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: show interest in music; show interest in learning; take an interest in sth
commonMistake: interest in 后接名词或动名词；不要说 show interest to sth。

example.english: The visitors showed interest in the students' robot project.
example.chinese: 参观者对学生们的机器人项目表现出兴趣。

application.solution: A。解析：对学习表达出兴趣用 show interest in。
application.prompt: The child ___ learning how to communicate clearly. A. showed interest in B. took place in

grammar: n. 听者，可数。动词 listen；常用 listen to。
collocations: a good listener; active listener; listen to the speaker
commonMistake: listener 指听的人；动词 listen 后接宾语时要加 to，如 listen to sb。

example.english: A good listener gives others time to finish speaking.
example.chinese: 好的倾听者会给别人时间把话说完。

application.solution: A。解析：认真听的人是 listener；speaker 是讲话的人。
application.prompt: A person who pays attention while someone speaks is a ___. A. listener B. speaker

grammar: n. 观点；重点；要点；v. 指向；瞄准。
collocations: make a point; point to a place; point at sth
commonMistake: point to 常表示指向某地或事物；point out 表示指出、说明某点。

example.english: She pointed to the line on the map.
example.chinese: 她指着地图上的那条线。

application.solution: B。解析：用手指向某处用 point to。
application.prompt: The guide used her hand to ___ the meeting room. A. pay for B. point to

grammar: adv. 想必；必定；无疑地。形容词为 sure。
collocations: surely know; surely understand; surely be able to
commonMistake: surely 是副词；be 后作表语用 sure，不要说 I am surely。

example.english: Surely we can find a better way to solve this problem.
example.chinese: 我们肯定能找到更好的办法解决这个问题。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 knows 需要副词 surely；sure 是形容词。
application.prompt: She ___ knows the answer. A. sure B. surely

grammar: v. 持续；继续做。常用 continue to do/doing sth，也可 continue with sth。
collocations: continue working; continue to study; continue with the discussion
commonMistake: continue 后可接 to do 或 doing；不要漏掉后面的 to 或 -ing。

example.english: The speaker continued answering questions after the talk.
example.chinese: 演讲结束后，发言者继续回答问题。

application.solution: A。解析：表示继续某项活动可用 continue with sth。
application.prompt: After a short break, the students continued ___ their rehearsal. A. with B. at

grammar: adj. 不礼貌的；粗鲁的。由 polite 加否定前缀 im- 构成。
collocations: impolite to interrupt; impolite behaviour; seem impolite
commonMistake: 常用 It is impolite to do sth；impolite 的反义词是 polite，拼写有前缀 im-。

example.english: It is impolite to look at your phone while someone is talking.
example.chinese: 别人讲话时看手机是不礼貌的。

application.solution: A。解析：It is 后需形容词 impolite；impoliteness 是名词。
application.prompt: It is ___ to interrupt a speaker before they finish. A. impolite B. impoliteness

grammar: adj. 个人的；私人的。名词 person；副词 personally。
collocations: personal information; personal experience; personal space
commonMistake: personal 是形容词；“个人地、亲自”可用 personally，不要和 personnel（全体员工）混淆。

example.english: Never share personal information with strangers online.
example.chinese: 不要在网上向陌生人分享个人信息。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 information 用形容词 personal。
application.prompt: Your name and phone number are ___ information. A. person B. personal

grammar: phr. 与某人争论；争吵。常与 about/over sth 连用。
collocations: argue with a friend; argue with sb about sth; argue over a plan
commonMistake: argue with 后接争论对象；争论的话题可用 about/over 引出。

example.english: I don't want to argue with my partner about the topic.
example.chinese: 我不想和搭档为这个话题争论。

application.solution: B。解析：与某人争论用 argue with sb。
application.prompt: Try to discuss the problem calmly instead of ___ your classmate. A. meeting with B. arguing with

grammar: phr. 换话题；开始做（别的事）；继续前进。
collocations: move on to a new topic; move on from a mistake; move on to the next task
commonMistake: 表示转到下一话题常用 move on to；不要漏掉介词 to。

example.english: After discussing the first question, the class moved on to the next topic.
example.chinese: 讨论完第一个问题后，全班转向了下一个话题。

application.solution: B。解析：转到下一题用 move on to。
application.prompt: We have finished this question. Let's ___ the next one. A. drop a line to B. move on to

grammar: adj. 真诚的；诚实的。副词 sincerely。
collocations: a sincere apology; sincere thanks; be sincere with sb
commonMistake: sincere 是形容词，sincerely 是副词；表达诚挚感谢可说 sincere thanks。

example.english: He gave a sincere apology after the misunderstanding.
example.chinese: 误会之后，他真诚地道了歉。

application.solution: A。解析：be 动词后作表语应用形容词 sincere。
application.prompt: Her apology sounded honest and ___. A. sincere B. sincerely

grammar: phr. 查明；弄清（情况）；发现信息。过去式 found out。
collocations: find out the truth; find out about a course; find it out
commonMistake: find out 强调查明信息；代词作宾语放在中间：find it out。

example.english: We need to find out when the meeting will begin.
example.chinese: 我们需要弄清会议什么时候开始。

application.solution: A。解析：查明某人的身份用 find out。
application.prompt: Can you ___ who sent this message? A. find out B. find on

grammar: v. 付费；交纳；偿还；n. 工资、薪水（常不可数）。过去式/过去分词 paid。
collocations: pay for a ticket; pay sb; pay a bill
commonMistake: pay for sth 表示为某物付费；pay sb sth 表示付给某人钱；过去式是不规则变化 paid。

example.english: I paid for the tickets online yesterday.
example.chinese: 我昨天在网上付了票钱。

application.solution: A。解析：人付钱用 pay；cost 常表示某物花费某人多少钱。
application.prompt: The verb meaning “give money for something” is ___. A. pay B. cost

grammar: n. 注意；专心；关注，通常不可数。
collocations: pay attention to; draw attention to; give sb your attention
commonMistake: attention 通常不可数；固定搭配 pay attention to 中 to 是介词。

example.english: Please give your full attention to the speaker.
example.chinese: 请专心听发言者讲话。

application.solution: A。解析：pay attention to 是固定表达，attention 通常不可数。
application.prompt: The teacher asked everyone to pay ___ to the instructions. A. attention B. attentions

grammar: phr. 注意；关注。to 为介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
collocations: pay attention to details; pay attention to sb; pay attention to doing sth
commonMistake: 短语中的 to 是介词，后接 doing 或名词；不要用动词原形。

example.english: Pay attention to what your partner is saying.
example.chinese: 注意听搭档正在说什么。

application.solution: B。解析：pay attention to 后接名词；traffic 表示道路交通时用 the traffic 或泛指 traffic，此处 the 合适。
application.prompt: When you cross the road, pay attention to ___ traffic. A. a B. the

grammar: phr. 行为自然；不做作；做你自己。
collocations: just be yourself; feel free to be yourself; be yourself around friends
commonMistake: be yourself 表示自然做自己；yourself 需随主语变化，如 be myself、be themselves。

example.english: You don't need to act differently; just be yourself.
example.chinese: 你不必表现得不一样，只要做你自己。

application.solution: A。解析：自然地表现自己用 be yourself。
application.prompt: Before the interview, remember to ___ and speak honestly. A. be yourself B. be a stranger

grammar: v. 提供；主动提出；提议；出价；n. 主动提议；出价。
collocations: offer help; offer to do sth; make an offer
commonMistake: offer sb sth 或 offer sth to sb 表示提供；offer to do 表示主动提出做某事。

example.english: The student offered to help the visitor find the library.
example.chinese: 这名学生主动提出帮访客找图书馆。

application.solution: A。解析：主动提出做某事用 offer to do。
application.prompt: When she saw the heavy boxes, she ___ carry one. A. offered to B. replied to

grammar: adj. 公平的；合理的。副词 reasonably。
collocations: a reasonable price; a reasonable decision; it is reasonable to do sth
commonMistake: reasonable 是形容词，reason 是名词；不要把 reasonable 拼成 reasonible。

example.english: It is reasonable to ask questions when you do not understand.
example.chinese: 不明白时提问是合理的。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 explanation 要用形容词 reasonable。
application.prompt: The teacher gave a ___ explanation for the change. A. reason B. reasonable

grammar: adj. 社会的；社交的；n. 联谊会、联欢会（尤见美式英语）。
collocations: social life; social skills; social event
commonMistake: social 表示“社会的、社交的”；sociable 更强调一个人善于交际，不要混为一谈。

example.english: Face-to-face talks can help build social skills.
example.chinese: 面对面交谈有助于培养社交技能。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰 relationships 需要形容词 social。
application.prompt: Learning to listen is important for good ___ relationships. A. society B. social

grammar: n. 媒介；手段；adj. 中等的；适中的。表示传播媒介时复数常用 media；mediums 也可用于其他语义。
collocations: a medium of communication; social media; a medium-sized room
commonMistake: medium 表示传播媒介时复数常用 media；表示“中等的”时是形容词，不能用 media 修饰名词。

example.english: Email is one medium people use to communicate.
example.chinese: 电子邮件是人们用来交流的一种媒介。

application.solution: A。解析：a 后用单数 medium；media 是 medium 表示传播媒介时常见的复数形式。
application.prompt: TV can be a useful ___ for sharing information. A. medium B. media

grammar: n. 社交媒体，通常作集合性表达。
collocations: on social media; social media platform; use social media
commonMistake: 表示在社交媒体平台上通常用 on social media；不要用 in social media。

example.english: Many students share school news on social media.
example.chinese: 许多学生在社交媒体上分享学校消息。

application.solution: A。解析：表示在社交媒体平台上通常用介词 on。
application.prompt: The club posted its announcement ___ last night. A. on social media B. in social media

grammar: n. 信任；v. 信任、相信。过去式/过去分词 trusted。
collocations: trust a friend; trust sb to do sth; build trust
commonMistake: trust 作动词时直接接宾语，不说 trust to sb；名词常用 build/gain trust。

example.english: Good friends listen carefully and trust each other.
example.chinese: 好朋友会认真倾听并彼此信任。

application.solution: A。解析：信任某人会做某事用 trust sb to do sth。
application.prompt: I ___ my partner to keep the information private. A. trust B. attention

grammar: phr. （使）远离；避免……靠近。结构可为 keep sb/sth away from sth。
collocations: keep children away from danger; keep away from a hot pan; keep pets away from food
commonMistake: keep ... away from 中 from 后接名词或动名词；不要遗漏 from。

example.english: Please keep your phone away from the water.
example.chinese: 请让手机远离水。

application.solution: B。解析：使某物远离某物用 keep sth away from sth。
application.prompt: The sign says we should ___ the equipment ___ water. A. make / up with B. keep / away from

grammar: n. 误解；误会，可数。动词为 misunderstand，过去式 misunderstood。
collocations: a misunderstanding between friends; clear up a misunderstanding; avoid misunderstanding
commonMistake: misunderstanding 是名词；动词过去式为 misunderstood，不是 misunderstanded。

example.english: They cleared up the misunderstanding by talking face to face.
example.chinese: 他们通过面对面交谈消除了误会。

application.solution: A。解析：导致朋友不再交谈的误会是 misunderstanding。
application.prompt: A small ___ caused the two friends to stop talking. A. misunderstanding B. communication

grammar: n. 公开活动；重要事情，可数。
collocations: a school event; attend an event; a major event
commonMistake: event 是可数名词；表示一场活动时单数前常用 a/an。

example.english: The school will hold a communication event for families.
example.chinese: 学校将为家庭举办一场交流活动。

application.solution: A。解析：学校举办的重要活动是 event。
application.prompt: The open day is an important school ___. A. event B. attention

grammar: phr. 发生；举行；进行。常用于活动、会议或事件；无被动语态。
collocations: the meeting takes place; take place in June; take place at school
commonMistake: take place 表示“发生、举行”，没有被动语态；不能说 was taken place。

example.english: The class reunion will take place next Saturday.
example.chinese: 班级聚会将于下周六举行。

application.solution: B。解析：活动“举行”用 take place，不能用被动语态。
application.prompt: The speech contest will ___ in the school hall. A. be taken place B. take place

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义与不规则变化
grammar: n. 费用；价钱；代价；v. 价钱为；使损失、使付出努力。过去式/过去分词 cost。
collocations: the cost of a ticket; cost a lot; cost sb time
commonMistake: cost 作动词时常用“物 + cost + 人 + 金钱/时间”；过去式仍为 cost，不加 -ed。

example.english: The trip cost us less than we expected.
example.chinese: 这趟旅行花的钱比我们预想的少。

application.solution: A。解析：叙述过去，cost 的过去式仍为 cost。
application.prompt: The tickets ___ twenty dollars last year. A. cost B. costs

grammar: n. 机会；时机，可数。
collocations: an opportunity to do sth; a good opportunity; have the opportunity of doing sth
commonMistake: opportunity 后常接 to do；不可说 opportunity for do。

example.english: The visit gave us an opportunity to practise speaking English.
example.chinese: 这次参观给了我们练习说英语的机会。

application.solution: B。解析：见教授的好机会是 opportunity。
application.prompt: This is a good ___ to meet the professor. A. misunderstanding B. opportunity

grammar: v. 对……有用；使受益；n. 益处；成效。
collocations: benefit from exercise; benefit sb; be of benefit to sb
commonMistake: benefit from sth 表示从某事中受益；benefit sb 表示使某人受益，不加 from。

example.english: Students benefit from practising conversations regularly.
example.chinese: 学生通过定期练习对话而受益。

application.solution: A。解析：从练习中受益用 benefit from。
application.prompt: People can ___ regular practice. A. benefit from B. reply to

grammar: phr. 从……获益；结构为 benefit from + 名词/代词/动名词。
collocations: benefit from a course; benefit from experience; benefit from doing sth
commonMistake: from 是介词，后接名词或动名词；不要说 benefit from do sth。

example.english: She benefited from joining the speaking club.
example.chinese: 她从参加演讲社团中受益。

application.solution: B。解析：从某事中获益用 benefit from，from 后接动名词 working。
application.prompt: He hopes to ___ working with an experienced speaker. A. pay for B. benefit from

grammar: n. 答复；v. 回答；回复。过去式/过去分词 replied。常用 reply to。
collocations: reply to a message; a quick reply; reply that ...
commonMistake: reply 作动词时通常要接 to 再接对象；answer 可直接接名词宾语。

example.english: Please reply to my message when you have time.
example.chinese: 有空时请回复我的信息。

application.solution: B。解析：reply 常用 reply to；answer 作动词时可直接接 it。
application.prompt: I sent her a question, but she did not ___ to it. A. answer to B. reply

grammar: n. 荣幸；尊敬；v. 尊敬；给予荣誉、表彰。美式拼写为 honor。
collocations: it is an honour to; honour sb for sth; in honour of
commonMistake: honour 是英式拼写，首字母后有 u；“荣幸地做某事”可说 It is an honour to ...。

example.english: It was an honour to meet the visiting professor.
example.chinese: 见到来访的教授是一种荣幸。

application.solution: A。解析：honour 以元音音素开头，前用 an。
application.prompt: It was ___ to speak at the school event. A. an honour B. a honour

grammar: adv. 真诚地；诚实地。形容词 sincere；也用于正式信件结尾 Yours sincerely。
collocations: sincerely hope; speak sincerely; Yours sincerely
commonMistake: sincerely 是副词；放在正式信件结尾时可写 Yours sincerely，注意首字母大写。

example.english: I sincerely hope we can solve the misunderstanding.
example.chinese: 我真诚地希望我们能解决这个误会。

application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 thanked 用副词 sincerely。
application.prompt: She thanked the volunteers ___ for their help. A. sincere B. sincerely

grammar: adj. 开篇的；开始的；n. 开始；开口、孔洞；也可指职位空缺。
collocations: opening speech; opening remarks; an opening in the wall
commonMistake: opening 可作形容词或名词；opening speech 表示开场发言，open 是动词或形容词。

example.english: The opening speech welcomed all the guests.
example.chinese: 开场发言欢迎了所有来宾。

application.solution: B。解析：活动开头的发言是 opening speech。
application.prompt: The first speech at the event is the ___ speech. A. closing B. opening

grammar: adj. 结尾的；结束的；n. 结束、关闭；停业。
collocations: closing speech; closing remarks; closing time
commonMistake: closing 可作形容词或名词；表示“关闭的”状态通常用 closed，不要混淆 closing 与 closed。

example.english: Her closing remarks thanked everyone for listening.
example.chinese: 她的结束语感谢了所有听众。

application.solution: A。解析：演讲末尾的发言是 closing remarks。
application.prompt: The final words of a speech are its ___ remarks. A. closing B. local

grammar: n. 句子；判决；v. 判决、宣判。
collocations: write a sentence; a complete sentence; sentence sb to ...
commonMistake: sentence 作“句子”时是可数名词；作动词表示判刑，注意与动词 sentencing 的语境差别。

example.english: Write one clear sentence to express your opinion.
example.chinese: 写一个清晰的句子来表达你的观点。

application.solution: A。解析：完整的书面表达单位是 sentence（句子）；speaker 指发言者。
application.prompt: In writing, end each complete thought with a ___. A. sentence B. speaker

grammar: n. 日期；日子；约会；v. 确定年代；注明日期；与某人约会。
collocations: the date of the meeting; date back to; write the date
commonMistake: date 可作名词或动词；“某事的日期”用 the date of ...；不要把 date 和 day 混为一谈。

example.english: Please write the date at the top of your letter.
example.chinese: 请在信的顶部写上日期。

application.solution: B。解析：询问聚会在哪一天举行时问 date；detail 指细节。
application.prompt: What is the ___ of the school reunion? A. detail B. date

grammar: n. 从句；分句，语法术语。
collocations: a main clause; a subordinate clause; a clause in a sentence
commonMistake: clause 指句子的一部分，phrase 指短语；从句不一定能独立成句。

example.english: The sentence has a main clause and a time clause.
example.chinese: 这个句子有一个主句和一个时间从句。

application.solution: A。解析：含主语和谓语、构成句子一部分的结构是 clause。
application.prompt: A group of words with a subject and a verb in a sentence can be a ___. A. clause B. line
